 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Itinerary** is correctly spelled and refers to a planned route or journey, typically used to describe travel schedules.
 
• Options 2, 3, and 4 (Itinary, Itinerery, Itinarey) are incorrect spellings of the word and do not exist in standard English.
 
• Correct spelling is essential for clear communication and maintaining professionalism, especially in written contexts.

Correct sentence: *The correctly spelt word is **Itinerary**.*

• **Tips to Avoid Spelling Errors:**
